title: What is BPH of rice?
content: Brown Planthopper (BPH) is a serious insect pest of rice that sucks sap from the base of the plant, causing yellowing, wilting, and drying of plants known as hopper burn.
retrieval_keywords: rice bph brown planthopper hopper burn
embedding_text: Brown planthopper is a rice pest that sucks sap and causes hopper burn symptoms

title: What is Deadheart of rice?
content: Dead heart refers to the drying and death of the central shoot in rice plants, usually caused by stem borer larvae feeding inside the stem. The central leaf becomes dry and can be easily pulled out.
embedding_text: Dead heart in rice is caused by stem borer larvae damaging the central shoot

title: What is False Smut of rice?
content: False smut is a fungal disease of rice where grains are replaced by greenish spore balls that later turn yellow or black, reducing grain quality and yield.
retrieval_keywords: rice false smut fungal grain disease
embedding_text: False smut in rice produces green spore balls replacing grains

title: What is Leaf Blast of rice?
content: Leaf blast is a fungal disease causing spindle-shaped lesions with gray centers and brown margins on rice leaves, leading to reduced photosynthesis and yield loss.
retrieval_keywords: rice leaf blast lesions fungal disease
embedding_text: Leaf blast causes spindle shaped lesions on rice leaves

title: What is Leaf Folder of rice?
content: Leaf folder is an insect pest whose larvae fold rice leaves and feed inside, scraping green tissues and reducing photosynthesis.
retrieval_keywords: rice leaf folder folded leaves pest
embedding_text: Leaf folder larvae fold rice leaves and feed inside causing damage

title: What is Neck Blast of rice?
content: Neck blast is a severe stage of blast disease where the neck of the panicle becomes infected, causing grains to remain empty or partially filled.
embedding_text: Neck blast infects the panicle neck leading to empty grains

title: What is Rice Bug of rice?
content: Rice bug is an insect pest that sucks sap from developing grains, causing discoloration, shriveling, and poor grain quality.
embedding_text: Rice bug damages grains by sucking sap during grain filling stage

title: What is Sheath Rot of rice?
content: Sheath rot is a fungal disease that affects the leaf sheath enclosing the panicle, causing rotting, discoloration, and poor grain development.
embedding_text: Sheath rot affects the sheath around panicle causing rot and poor grains

title: What is Stem Borer Egg Mass of rice?
content: Stem borer egg masses are clusters of small eggs laid on rice leaves, usually covered with hairs or scales, which later hatch into damaging larvae.
retrieval_keywords: rice stem borer egg mass identification
embedding_text: Stem borer egg masses appear as clusters on rice leaves covered with hairs

title: What is Stem Borer Larva of rice?
content: Stem borer larvae are caterpillar-like insects that bore into rice stems and feed internally, causing dead heart and whitehead symptoms.
embedding_text: Stem borer larvae bore into rice stems and cause dead heart

title: What is Stem Borer Moth of rice?
content: Stem borer moth is the adult stage of the pest that lays eggs on rice plants, leading to larval infestation which damages the crop.
retrieval_keywords: rice stem borer moth adult pest
embedding_text: Stem borer moth lays eggs which hatch into damaging larvae
